title: Pear and Precision
description: Warming and complex with a balance of fruit and spice, this slow sipper is in a similar territory to an Old Fashioned, with a lighter and more fragrant profile.
notes: For a smokier flavor, use a peated Scotch Whiskey.
Experiment with different fruit liqueurs for a unique twist.

title: Soshi
description: A light, elegant, and herbaceous beverage, finished with rosemary and orange for a garden-fresh lift.
notes: The Scotch should be measured carefully — it's a background note, not a feature. Too much will overpower the delicate florals.
Allow to rosemary to form embers before smoking the glass for a more intense aroma.

title: Lily Bee
description: Tasting exactly like a lemon sherbet, this zingy cocktail embodies the a bumblebee's journey through a summer meadow, with a bright and refreshing profile that’s perfect for sipping on a sunny day.
notes: Adjust the honeycomb syrup to taste depending on the sweetness of your gin, some lemon gins vary significantly in sugar content.
Use fresh lemon juice only, bottled juice will flatten the brightness this cocktail relies on.

title: Carajillo
description: A bold and seductive after-dinner cocktail where smoky collides with vanilla-sweet complexity, resting on a punchy espresso backbone.
notes: Use a freshly pulled espresso shot where possible — cold brew or instant will lose the crema that gives this cocktail its texture and mouthfeel.
Experiment with different styles of mezcal, some will add a more herbal or fruity note that can complement the vanilla sweetness of the Licor 43.

title: Dream of a Bee
description: A surrealist in a glass. Inspired by Dalí's dreamlike vision, this cocktail layers a floral sting and lifted breath. Effervescent, aromatic, and hauntingly beautiful.
notes: The pomegranate and clove cordial carries both sweetness and spice, so taste before adding the full measure of honey syrup and adjust accordingly.

title: Elephants
description: A rich and indulgent digestivo inspired by Dalí's towering elephants. Impossibly elegant yet grounded in dark, earthy depth. The wild fruit and cream drift over a weighted warming undertone, anchored by the a herbaceous complexity. Slow, luxurious, and dreamlike.
pairings: Slow Rosted Lamb with a Dark Jus
notes: Clarified Liqueur Recipe: Combine equal parts Amarula and sweet vermouth, add a dash of cacao bitters for every 100ml of liquid. Allow the batch to sit in the fridge for 1 hour and pour through a coffee filter/cheese cloth. Repeat until you are left with a clear, golden blend.

title: Woman with Drawers
description: A visually arresting non-alcoholic cocktail inspired by Dalí's enigmatic figure, beautiful on the surface, layered with hidden complexity beneath. Light, fruity, and ethereal with a theatrical colour change that makes it as much a performance as a drink.
notes: The colour change is the spectacle, add the lemon juice last and in view of the guest for full effect.
Use a good quality white grape soda. Thin or overly sweet soda will flatten the delicate notes.

title: Temptation of St. Anthony
description: A seductive and disorienting cocktail inspired by Dalí's vision of desire and temptation. Beautiful, beguiling, and quietly dangerous.
notes: Birch caramel liqueur varies significantly in sweetness between producers. Taste before measuring and reduce the syrup slightly if the liqueur is particularly sweet.

title: Persistance of Time
description: A contemplative and unhurried cocktail inspired by Dalí's melting clocks. Time dissolving at the edges, familiar forms losing their rigidity. The sandy body, accompanied by the white foam, drawing for the famous painting and its pallette.
notes: The orange foam should be applied gently over the back of a spoon to preserve the layered effect
To make the garnish, coat an orange wheel with sugar, rest over a 90° angle and flame with a torch until the sugar melts and the wheel retains its shape.

title: Classic Margarita
description: The Margarita is the bartender's litmus test. Blanco tequila stripped bare by the sharp clarity of fresh lime, softened just enough by the bitter orange warmth of Cointreau, and framed by the salted rim that transforms every sip. Bright, uncompromising, and eternally refreshing.
notes: Use a good quality blanco tequila, the purity of the base is crucial in a quality margarita.

title: Park Road
ingredients: Topped with Raspberry and Chocolate Whipped Cream
